blocks.text: Rizza Amimita Dizon, mom of “Eat Bulaga” host Ryzza Mae Dizon, revealed they received death threats from an unknown individual demanding money in exchange for their safety. Through her Facebook page, Team Ryzza, Rizza shared a screenshot of an email from an unidentified sender demanding ₱20,000 for their child’s alleged operation.
